accounting: Preallocation retains whole-job disk cap. Its exact bound job reserves zero additional disk but all other resources normally. Submit verifies both ledger charges; inventory observes actual disk on the original preallocation, max(reserved,actual), without refund.
coverage: Exact registration, submission and replay use one disk charge
Missing owner, reduced charge, altered purpose and wrong binding reject before submission claim
Crash after binding before job intent preserves storage and recovers the same spec
Actual output overrun raises owner charge and job inventory violation; replay is idempotent
substitutes: Temporary Store/Journal and actual registration/submit validation orchestration
Authority inspection, kernel volume checks and process submission replaced by CPU fixtures
Inventory routing uses explicit owner-boundary substitute; owner validation tested separately
No single full production end-to-end execution or real mount in this suite
